name: Tejal Anant Narvekar
headline: Senior Functional Consultant
summary:
Supply Chain and Demand Planning professional with 3.5 years of experience at o9 Solutions, working on demand planning and
Integrated Business Planning (IBP) initiatives. Experienced in designing Constrained Revenue Plans (CRP), contributing to IBP
processes, and translating business requirements into solution builds. Client-facing experience includes understanding stakeholder
needs, clarifying requirements and shaping functional solutions. Currently building AI-enabled applications using retrieval-augmented
generation and agent-orchestration technologies.

projects.name: Supplier Risk Analyser — AI-Enabled Supplier Risk Assessment & Comparison Platform
projects.description: Supplier management: Create and maintain a centralized supplier register, retrieve supplier-specific information and access assessment history. Document intelligence: Process uploaded audit reports, annual reports and financial documents to extract information relevant to supplier evaluation. Financial and delivery risk: Analyse structured financial metrics from CSV files and shipment/delivery performance data to identify financial vulnerabilities and operational reliability issues. Risk scoring and comparison: Generate supplier risk scores and classifications using available evidence; compare two suppliers’ scores and supporting information to assess relative strengths, weaknesses and risk. Objective: Reduce manual assessment effort and provide procurement teams with a structured, evidence-based approach to supplier evaluation and selection. Technology: Python, FastAPI, LangGraph, SQLAlchemy, SQLite/PostgreSQL, Streamlit, PyMuPDF, structured CSV processing and Tavily (optional external research).

availability: Open to remote roles. Notice period: 30 days.
